mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with eslicarbazepine increases risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome; eslicarbazepine may induce metabolism of phenelzine while phenelzine inhibits CYP3A4.
action: Avoid combination or use with extreme caution with close blood pressure monitoring and washout periods; consider alternative anticonvulsant with safer MAOI profile.
